name: Intel Alder Lake / Raptor Lake (12th / 13th / 14th Gen Desktop)
description: Modern Intel hybrid architecture desktop (LGA1700). Requires a supported discrete GPU (AMD Radeon) because integrated UHD 770/730 graphics have zero native macOS support.

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-PLUG-ALT.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: Mandatory on LGA1700 to provide CPU power management for CP00-style ACPI processor objects (replaces SSDT-PLUG).

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-EC-USBX.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: Creates fake Embedded Controller and specifies USB bus power limits.

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-AWAC.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: Forces legacy RTC clock enable instead of unsupported AWAC timer.

igpu.name: Intel UHD 770/730 (Unsupported)
igpu.warning: Intel UHD 730/750/770 has no drivers in macOS. You must boot using a compatible AMD Radeon dGPU (RX 6600, 6800, 6900 XT, or 500 series) and add '-wegnoigpu' to boot-args.

amdDgpu.navi10_21_note: AMD Navi 21/23 (RX 6600, 6600 XT, 6800, 6800 XT, 6900 XT) works natively with 'agdpmod=pikera'.
amdDgpu.unsupportedWarning: AMD RX 6700 XT requires NootRX kext. RX 6500 XT, 6400, and RX 7000 series are unsupported.
